diagnosis: In this multi-site Django deployment where multiple independent brand storefronts share a unified user base, CustomerOrder possesses a 'site' ForeignKey. OrderDetailView checks customer=request.user but fails to filter by site=get_current_site(request). An authenticated customer on Storefront A (e.g. budget brand) can view their discreet or confidential purchase history from Storefront B (e.g. luxury or medical brand) by providing the order ID.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/orders/ORD-LUX-881903/ HTTP/1.1
Host: budget-supplies.commerce-group.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt_token>
Accept: application/json
